changelog:
Initial release: enables image generation and editing using Gemini 3 Pro Image via Replicate API.

- Supports user-invocable image generation with customizable prompts, aspect ratios, and output paths.
- Exclusively uses the google/nano-banana-pro model (no fallback to alternatives).
- Automatically sends generated images directly in chat.
- Safety filtering enabled by default; resolutions up to 2K supported.
- Requires REPLICATE_API_TOKEN and the "uv" binary.
summary: Generate or edit images via Gemini 3 Pro Image on Replicate
